title: Headless TTW Death From Above (DLC03BS1): from the player awake in the Citadel after Take it Back! through Rothchild's briefing, Liberty Prime's march on the Enclave relay station and the telemetry data to Elder Lyons (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Joins Take it Back! after the purifier's code (MQ11 61, Sarah entered it: the MQ11 chain). The end of the ending slides (EndingBinks' script [observed]) puts the player at DLC03PlayerStartMarker in the Citadel and sets DLC03BS1 0; done here directly so this chain runs alone. The quest's script then wakes the player (stages 1 and 2).

Stand-in for Rothchild's walk to the Citadel's map and the player stepping in front of it: he is put at his map marker and the player at the map; Rothchild's script [observed] then starts his briefing (DLC03BS1RothchildMapLines, said to himself, each SayToDone starting the next).
Travel stand-in: to Paladin Tristan at the Rockland car tunnel.

Stand-in for Liberty Prime's march with the Pride on the Enclave's relay station and the orbital strike that destroys it (the AI: Prime's packages and DLC03PrimeScript's states); the strike's step of that script [observed] sets DLC03BS1.DLC03PrimeDown 1, set here as that step would.

The relay station's front door 0x0D000B16 (lock 255) is unlocked by SCPT 0x0D003224 on ref 0x0D003223: while its trackvariable is 1 it runs Liberty Prime's 20 s crawl timer, then sets it to 2 and unlocks the door; Prime's script sets it with DLC03PrimeDown [observed: round 12 triage]. The trigger SCPT 0x0D00D550 is inside the station by the back door (for leaving), no way in. Stand-in for Prime's script: the variable, then the timer's wait.

actions.label: tristan: what the hell just happened (stage 30)
milestone: DLC03BS1 30, into the relay station

actions.text: Travel stand-in: through the relay station to its terminal: Request New Telemetry Data (DLC03TerminalUpdate 1), then Download Telemetry Data to User Device [observed] (stage 40).

Stand-in for Liberty Prime's hook punch on the Enclave's second tower on the march (DLC03PrimeScript 0x0D001FCE [observed]: kills and disables DLC03PrimeWalkTowerBTurretD-G, enables their hulks and knocks out TurretA-C). A player walks behind Prime while he does it; skipped, the turrets on the tower shoot the player before the relay (round 15: 60 s fights not won, the player stranded on the tower).

Travel stand-in: to the relay station's front door DLC03ExteriortoDLC03Relay01REF (0x0D000B16, lock 255), where a player stands when Prime falls. The torso timer ref DLC03PrimeTorsoTimerREF (0x0D003223) is not persistent and sits by that door in DLC03RelayStation: its 20 s timer runs only while the player is there (round 15 [observed]: its playgroups ran 1-20 s after the player arrived), then it unlocks the door. Waited out here so the walk inside is planned with the door open.

actions.label: milestone: DLC03BS1 40, back to the Citadel

actions.text: Travel stand-in: back to the Citadel; the data to Rothchild (stage 50), then Elder Lyons (stage 200).

actions.label: rothchild: all those years of work
